free_text: The 76-year-old male presents with a significantly elevated PSA of 13.6 ng/mL and a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the mid transition zone, correlating with a prior ISUP grade group 1 adenocarcinoma. The MRI shows a suspicious lesion with restricted diffusion, and the clinical stage is cT1c. Given the low-grade histology and clinical stage, the management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of treatment against patient preferences and the known extent of the disease.
